MODELS = {

        "num_layers": 28,
        "num_kv_heads": 4,

        "baseline_ppl": 7.035,
        "uniform4_ppl": 7.131,
        "mckp_ppl": 7.323,
    },
}


def build_l0_allocation(num_layers, num_kv_heads):
    allocation = {}
    for layer in range(num_layers):
        for head in range(num_kv_heads):
            key = f"{layer},{head}"
            if layer == 0:
                allocation[key] = ["quant", 8]
            else:
                allocation[key] = ["quant", 4]
    total_heads = num_layers * num_kv_heads
    l0_heads = num_kv_heads
    rest_heads = total_heads - l0_heads
    budget = (l0_heads * 8 + rest_heads * 4) / (total_heads * 16)
    return allocation, budget


def run_single_model(name, cfg, device):
    print(f"\n{'='*60}")
    print(f"Model: {name}")
    print(f"{'='*60}")

    allocation, budget = build_l0_allocation(cfg["num_layers"], cfg["num_kv_heads"])
    print(f"L0-only allocation: {cfg['num_kv_heads']} heads@8bit + "
          f"{cfg['num_layers']*cfg['num_kv_heads'] - cfg['num_kv_heads']} heads@4bit")
    print(f"Budget ratio: {budget:.4f}")

    print(f"Loading model from {cfg['path']}...")
    t0 = time.time()
    tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(cfg["path"])
    model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(
        cfg["path"], torch_dtype=torch.bfloat16, attn_implementation="eager"
    )
    model = model.to(device)
    model.eval()
    print(f"Model loaded in {time.time()-t0:.1f}s")

    orig_fwds = patch_attention(model, allocation)
    t0 = time.time()
    l0_ppl = evaluate_perplexity(model, tokenizer, device, stride=512)
    eval_time = time.time() - t0
    restore_attention(model, orig_fwds)

    print(f"\nResults for {name}:")
    print(f"  L0-only PPL:   {l0_ppl:.4f}  (budget={budget:.4f})")
    print(f"  MCKP PPL:      {cfg['mckp_ppl']:.4f}  (budget=0.25)")
    print(f"  Uniform 4-bit: {cfg['uniform4_ppl']:.4f}")
    print(f"  Baseline bf16: {cfg['baseline_ppl']:.4f}")
    print(f"  L0 vs MCKP:    {l0_ppl - cfg['mckp_ppl']:+.4f}")
    print(f"  Eval time:     {eval_time:.1f}s")

    del model, tokenizer
    gc.collect()
    torch.cuda.empty_cache()

    return {
        "model": name,
        "l0_ppl": round(l0_ppl, 4),
        "budget": round(budget, 4),
        "mckp_ppl": cfg["mckp_ppl"],
        "uniform4_ppl": cfg["uniform4_ppl"],
        "baseline_ppl": cfg["baseline_ppl"],
        "l0_minus_mckp": round(l0_ppl - cfg["mckp_ppl"], 4),
        "eval_time_s": round(eval_time, 1),
    }


def main():
    import argparse
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="L0-only heuristic baseline evaluation")
    parser.add_argument("--gpu", type=int, default=0)
    parser.add_argument("--model_name", type=str, default=None,
                        help="Run single model (e.g. Qwen2.5-7B). Default: run all.")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    device = f"cuda:{args.gpu}"
    print(f"Using device: {device}")

    if args.model_name:

        if not matched:
            print(f"Unknown model: {args.model_name}. Available: {list(MODELS.keys())}")

        models_to_run = matched
    else:
        models_to_run = MODELS

    all_results = []
    for name, cfg in models_to_run.items():
        result = run_single_model(name, cfg, device)
        all_results.append(result)

    output_path = "/root/ratekv/l0_heuristic_results.json"
    with open(output_path, "w") as f:
        json.dump(all_results, f, indent=2)
    print(f"\nResults saved to {output_path}")

    print("\n" + "="*60)
    print("SUMMARY")
    print("="*60)
    print(f"{'Model':<20} {'L0 PPL':>8} {'MCKP':>8} {'Unif4':>8} {'BF16':>8} {'L0-MCKP':>8}")
    for r in all_results:
        print(f"{r['model']:<20} {r['l0_ppl']:>8.4f} {r['mckp_ppl']:>8.4f} "
              f"{r['uniform4_ppl']:>8.4f} {r['baseline_ppl']:>8.4f} {r['l0_minus_mckp']:>+8.4f}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
